notes.title: 🎃🎃🎃Halloween is here!🎃🎃🎃
notes.content:
[h3]Meow Catlovers!🎃😻🦇[/h3]

[b]We promised — we did![/b]

It's no secret that Halloween is closely associated with cats..🎃🐈
In honor of the holiday, we have prepared new content for you as part of the [b]Catellite-609[/b]!

We're happy to announce that 
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2136151/Catellite609_feline_space_adventure___Mysterious_Sphere/]Catellite-609: feline space adventure — Mysterious Sphere[/url][/b] available with [b]15% discount[/b] on Steam!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2136151/Catellite609_feline_space_adventure___Mysterious_Sphere/][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2136151/header.jpg?t=1666237169[/img][/url]

[i]DLC includes:
- 3 new soundtracks
- New mechanics (collectible)
- Unique metal parts at each stage (4-14)
- Sound and visual effects
- Hint about future project[/i]


In addition owners of the main game [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1747790/Catellite609_feline_space_adventure]Catellite-609: feline space adventure[/url][/b] will be able to immerse themselves in the atmosphere of the Halloween event! The event will run [b]until November 7th[/b].

[i]Event includes:
- Unique costumes for the crew
- Bats on board
- Space pumpkins and candles[/i]


Don't forget to buy candy and pet your pet!🎃😻🦇

[i]With love,
ZorKI Team[/i]ːsteamthisː

=^_^= Meow-meow =^_^=

notes.title: ⚠️🙀 Hotfix Version: 1.2 🙀⚠️
notes.content:
[h2]😻Hello cat lovers!😻[/h2]

[u][b]Fixed bugs:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] [b]Achievement[/b] - before the last achievement could not be obtained, but now you can;) If you completed the game, you can get it just by continuing the game and going through the last stage again.
[*] [b]Button control[/b] - improved room and UI navigation
[*] [b]Time format in research room[/b] - fixed display of mission types timer
[/list]

Thanks for your playtests, let's improve together, cats!😽
Good luck, have fun captain! 


=^_^= Meow-meow =^_^=

notes.title: ⚠️🙀 Hotfix Version: 1.1 🙀⚠️
notes.content:
[h2]😻Hello cat lovers!😻[/h2]

First of all, thank you very much for your interest in the project!
To date, we have already collected [b]1000+ wishlists[/b] and sold [b]100+ copies[/b] at a [b]33% discount![/b]

Thank you so much for all your feedback, we hear you!
Therefore, we have released an update with fixes and features.

[u][b]Fixed bugs:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] [b]UI[/b] - now we do not hide the panels when the camera approaches and enters the rooms
[*] [b]Solar panels[/b] - when buying a new solar panel, the previous one will be automated
[*] [b]Navigation[/b] - improved room navigation
[*] [b]Control room[/b] - now the cat-robot turns in the report on the completion of stage 17+ correctly
[*] [b]Tutorial[/b] - now the training starts at a convenient moment
[*] [b]Ultrawide resolutions🤍🤍🤍[/b] - now the mod-display in the window has been changed, you can change the window to the size you need
[/list]

Thanks for your playtests, let's improve together, cats!😽
Good luck, have fun captain! 

[i]P.S. don't try to change the application window to other aspect ratio than 16:9... please, we are working on it.[/i]


=^_^= Meow-meow =^_^=
